title: Ercot Power Market Outlook 2026: A Balancing Act | BloombergNEF
gist: Teaser executive summary of BNEF's Ercot Power Market Outlook 2026: data centers are driving extreme demand growth in Texas, with the supply-demand balance hinging on large-load interconnection speed and on-site generation; BNEF sees 2030 Ercot power averaging $44/MWh, 21% below the forward curve, with 103GW peak summer load.

insights.claim: Data centers are pushing Ercot, the Texas grid operator, into a period of extreme demand growth, with expected peak summer load of 103GW in 2030.
insights.speaker: BloombergNEF (free content)
insights.so_what: Texas is the epicenter of US load growth; relevant to Texas generators, gas, and storage developers.

insights.claim: Ercot's supply-demand balance will ultimately be determined by how quickly large new loads can connect to the grid and how much data center demand is served by on-site generation, even as new gas, renewable and storage capacity expands supply.
insights.speaker: BloombergNEF (free content)
insights.so_what: Interconnection queue speed and behind-the-meter adoption are the key variables to track for Texas power prices.

insights.claim: BNEF forecasts an average Ercot power price of $44/MWh in 2030, 21% below the forward curve.
insights.speaker: BloombergNEF (free content)
insights.so_what: BNEF sees Texas forwards as overpricing scarcity; a potential short-forward/long-hedge signal or a warning for merchant-generator valuations.
